A dramatic vertical science-fiction battle unfolds across the cratered surface of the Moon. In the lower center, a lone astronaut in a bulky gray spacesuit stands with their back toward the viewer, bracing a large shoulder-mounted cannon that erupts with a bright orange muzzle flash. Ahead rises a dark, battered industrial fortress crowded with towers, antennas, scaffolding, and scattered red lights. Filling the sky above it is a massive formation of blocky, cube-shaped alien invaders inspired by classic arcade graphics. Their squared faces have glowing red eyes and dark rectangular mouths. Several of the largest invaders dominate the upper half of the scene while many smaller ones recede toward the horizon, creating the impression of an overwhelming attacking swarm. Brilliant green energy beams and streaking projectiles descend diagonally from the invaders toward the lunar base. Orange defensive fire cuts upward through smoke, dust, sparks, and flying debris. A huge cratered moon or planet fills much of the upper-right background, illuminating the chaotic battlefield with cold pale light. The combination of voxel-like enemies, futuristic realism, glowing laser fire, and a solitary defender transforms the visual language of a retro arcade game into an enormous cinematic lunar war.

images.alt:
National Happiness Happens Day is celebrated in the United States every year on August 8th. The purpose of this day is to recognize and promote the joy of happiness, to encourage people to share moments of happiness, and to inspire individuals to focus on the positive aspects of life.
Origins and Background:
Founded by: The day was initiated by the Secret Society of Happy People in 1999. The organization, founded by Pamela Gail Johnson in 1998, encourages people to express their happiness and celebrate happy moments, big or small.
• Original Name: The day was originally called "Admit You're Happy Day" but was later renamed to "Happiness Happens Day."

Purpose.
• To celebrate happiness in all its forms.
• To encourage people to acknowledge and express when they are happy.
• To inspire others to seek out and
recognize their own happiness.

How to Celebrate:
• Share happiness: Smile at others, share good news, or post happy moments online.
• Acknowledge happy moments: Take a moment to reflect on and appreciate things that make you happy.
• Spread positivity: Do something kind for someone else, or simply enjoy what makes you feel good.
